label: Validation versus manufacturing test
subgoals: Separate design bugs found in validation from defects found in test
Map pass and fail over voltage and frequency with a shmoo plot
Treat failures on every die as design bugs

label: Seeing inside: traces and triggers
subgoals: Trigger trace capture on a programmable condition
Divide the entries by the entries per sample for the cycle window
Select traced signals that let untraced state be reconstructed

label: Scan dumps and reproduction
subgoals: Stop the clocks at a trigger and shift out the scan chains
Reproduce the localized window in simulation or emulation
Fix with spare cells, metal-only ECOs or patches where available
